contract.span: one common half-open integer frame domain [0, frame_count)
contract.response_contract: externally supplied unique ordered response centers and paired finite logits; not acoustic-event labels
contract.clock_contract: complete supplied clock family rendered over the whole domain; no truth-derived clock discovery
contract.assignment: chronological, one response per tick and one tick per response
contract.inventory_objective: maximum matched responses, then minimum total absolute frame offset; not a musical model score
contract.tie_accounting: count every distinct optimal matching once and report exact pair/tick/response occurrence counts
contract.witness_tie: match before skipping a tick, then nearest response, then earlier response; one diagnostic witness only
